info.title: Player Service read-only Express integration
info.description: Contract for the five opt-in Player Service reads, not an Express API, MCP server, or verified Nexla import format. Filtering is part of search, statistics, and rankings. Only historical biographical attributes are available; no performance statistics, player-quality rankings, measurement-unit guarantees, or freshness guarantees are implied. Authentication precedes validation, routing errors, and database access throughout /integrations/express/v1. The integration is disabled by default; disabled URLs return the legacy application's normal 404, outside this contract. Each query parameter may appear at most once; unknown parameters, empty values, malformed pairs, and invalid UTF-8/percent encoding are rejected. The encoded query string is capped at 4096 bytes (414). Integer query values require canonical unsigned ASCII decimal notation without leading zeros. GET/HEAD bodies are rejected when Content-Length is nonzero or Transfer-Encoding is present. Automatic HEAD executes the bounded read without a response body; authenticated OPTIONS performs no database read. Only GET operations are tool candidates. Namespace routing failures use the NotFound and MethodNotAllowed response components. SQLite schema inspection and operation reads have separate configured deadlines, not a hard total HTTP timeout. See docs/express-api.md in the repository for runtime configuration and production gates.

servers.description: Relative service origin; no deployed host is supplied. Configure an operator-approved HTTPS origin for remote use. Loopback HTTP is for local development only.

tags.name: Players
tags.description: Bounded, deterministic reads of the existing private SQLite data through Flask. No SQL or mutations are exposed.

get.description: AND-combine optional filters. Return full stored records ordered by playerId using binary collation. The page and total share one read snapshot; separate page requests do not guarantee the same revision. An empty population or page is a successful empty data array. Preserve pagination and request_id when binding tools; extracting only $.data loses traversal metadata.

200.description: A bounded page with snapshot-consistent population totals.

get.summary: Retrieve a player by exact ID
get.description: Match the decoded ID case-sensitively without trimming, normalization, or a second percent-decoding pass. No query parameters are supported. Data is one full record, not an array. An absent valid ID returns 404 player_not_found; duplicate selected stored IDs return 503. An encoded slash may create extra path segments and therefore a routing 404 not_found instead of a validation 400.

get.summary: Summarize the entire filtered player population
get.description: AND-combine the shared filters and summarize all matching players in one snapshot, not a page. Group limits independently cap categories for birthCountry, bats, and throws. Empty populations return zero counts, null numeric measures, and empty groups. There is no pagination, arbitrary grouping, or top-level data array: preserve total, numeric, groups, and request_id rather than using $.data.

200.description: Full-population numeric and bounded categorical summaries with explicit missing and omitted counts.

get.summary: Rank players by a source numeric attribute
get.description: Require an allowlisted metric and AND-combine shared filters. Sort numerically in the requested direction, then by playerId ascending using binary collation in both directions. Exclude null metrics and report their full-population count separately; pagination.total counts rankable players. Empty/all-null populations are successful. Do not interpret these orderings as player quality or performance. Preserve metric, direction, excluded_count, pagination, and request_id alongside data.

200.description: A bounded, stably ordered page; total plus excluded_count equals the full filtered population size.

get.summary: Compare an ordered selection of two to five players
get.description: Read all selected players in one snapshot and return full records in input order. Return each unordered pair in input-position order, with left-minus-right differences for birthYear, height, and weight. A difference is null if either value is unknown. Any missing ID returns 404 without partial results. No filters or pagination are supported. Bind player_ids as one comma-separated query value, not repeated parameters, and retain differences and request_id alongside data.

200.description: Two to five full records and all one to ten pairwise differences.

PlayerServiceBearer.description: Dedicated opaque Player Service token, not a JWT or Nexla service key. Send Authorization with the case-insensitive Bearer scheme, exactly one space, and the case-sensitive token. Provision 43-256 URL-safe ASCII characters generated from at least 32 cryptographically random bytes through approved secret storage. Never put the credential in a tool argument, URL, example, or committed file. HTTPS is required for remote use.

RequestId.name: X-Request-ID
RequestId.description: Optional correlation value, not identity or authentication. Values matching the RequestId response schema are echoed; missing or invalid values are replaced with a UUID, not rejected.

SearchText.name: q
SearchText.description: Literal substring of playerId, first/last/given name, or first + space + last name. Printable Unicode only; whitespace-only text is invalid. No trimming or normalization. Percent, underscore, and backslash are literals, not wildcards. SQLite folds ASCII case only.

BirthCountry.name: birth_country
BirthCountry.description: Exact case-sensitive country. Printable Unicode only; whitespace-only text is invalid. No trimming or normalization; apostrophes are data.

BirthYearMin.name: birth_year_min
BirthYearMin.description: Inclusive lower birth-year bound. Must not exceed birth_year_max when both are supplied. Unknown years do not match. Canonical unsigned ASCII decimal only.

BirthYearMax.name: birth_year_max
BirthYearMax.description: Inclusive upper birth-year bound. Must not be less than birth_year_min when both are supplied. Unknown years do not match. Canonical unsigned ASCII decimal only.

Throws.name: throws
Throws.description: Exact, case-sensitive throwing-handedness filter, including the source's recorded S value.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Maximum returned page size, not a population limit. Canonical unsigned ASCII decimal only.

Offset.name: offset
Offset.description: Zero-based page offset. Canonical unsigned ASCII decimal only. Narrow filters when the supported window is insufficient.

GroupLimit.name: group_limit
GroupLimit.description: Independent category cap for each grouped field, not a player limit. No group pagination. Canonical unsigned ASCII decimal only.

Metric.name: metric
Metric.description: Required source numeric attribute; no default, arbitrary expression, or performance statistic.

Direction.name: direction
Direction.description: Numeric ordering direction. Player-ID tie-breaks remain ascending in either direction.

PlayerId.name: player_id
PlayerId.description: Exact, case-sensitive ASCII alphanumeric player ID after one URL-decoding pass.

PlayerIds.name: player_ids
PlayerIds.description: One comma-separated value containing 2-5 distinct IDs in requested order. Percent-encoded commas are accepted. Repeated keys, duplicate IDs, empty elements, surrounding spaces, and alternative separators are invalid.

RequestId.description: Correlation identifier, equal to request_id in every JSON body.

NoStore.description: Integration responses must not be cached.

Allow.description: Allowed methods on a matched read route: GET, HEAD, OPTIONS. Header ordering is not significant.

PlayerId.description: Validated lookup/comparison input. Stored IDs in search/ranking records are not normalized to this input format.

NullableNumber.description: Finite source number or unknown (null); not necessarily an integer. Units are not established by this repository.

Player.description: All 24 fields of the supported SQLite/CSV schema, with original casing and nullable values. Years, months, days, height, and weight retain numeric (including fractional) values. Career dates remain source strings, without an asserted date format. No data migration or normalization is performed.

next_offset.description: offset + limit only when more rows exist and that offset is at most 100000; otherwise null. Null can mean the supported window is exhausted, not a complete traversal. Compare collected rows with total and narrow filters if necessary.

NumericSummary.description: known_count + missing_count equals the full filtered population. Null values are excluded from min/max/mean; all three measures are null when known_count is zero. Zero is known, not missing.

GroupSummary.description: Categories sorted by count descending then binary value ascending. SQL NULL contributes only to missing_count; empty strings and literal Unknown remain known values. known_count + missing_count equals the full population. Sum of returned category counts + other_count equals known_count.

other_count.description: Players in omitted categories, not the number of omitted categories. A positive value means the distribution is truncated.

numeric.description: Left value minus right value, or null if either is unknown. No age or unit conversion is performed.

differences.description: Every unordered pair in input-position order. For [a,b,c], pairs are (a,b), (a,c), (b,c).

message.description: Safe diagnostic, not credentials, raw inputs, player IDs, SQL, database paths, or exception messages.

InvalidRequest.description: 400 invalid_request: invalid, ambiguous, or unsupported input, including a declared GET/HEAD body. No database read is performed for invalid inputs.

Unauthorized.description: 401 unauthorized: missing, malformed, duplicate, or incorrect bearer credential. Authentication precedes all routing, parsing, and reads.

error.message: A valid bearer token is required

NotFound.description: 404 not_found: authenticated request to an unknown URL inside the integration namespace. This is a routing error, not an empty population.

PlayerNotFound.description: 404 player_not_found: one or more requested IDs are absent. No partial data or echoed missing IDs.

MethodNotAllowed.description: 405 method_not_allowed: authenticated request using an unsupported method on a known integration route.

RequestTooLarge.description: 414 request_too_large: encoded query string exceeds 4096 bytes, checked after authentication and before query parsing or database access.

InternalError.description: 500 internal_error: unexpected failure with sanitized diagnostics; never an empty success.

StorageUnavailable.description: 503 storage_unavailable: missing, locked, corrupt, or unusable storage; invalid/nonfinite JSON or numeric analytics; duplicate selected detail/comparison IDs; or arithmetic overflow. No partial results.

QueryTimeout.description: 504 query_timeout: cooperative SQLite read deadline exceeded; not a hard HTTP wall-clock deadline or an empty result.
